description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource for managing global configuration settings in the Fineract platform. It provides endpoints to retrieve and update various global configuration parameters, including reading configurations by ID, name, and listing all configurations. It utilizes Jakarta RESTful Web Services (JAX-RS), Swagger annotations, Lombok, and Spring components to implement its functionality.

classes.name: GlobalConfigurationApiResource
classes.description: REST controller providing endpoints for fetching and updating global configuration settings in Fineract.

methods.name: retrieveConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a list of global configuration settings, optionally including survey-related configurations, based on the query parameter.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific global configuration identified by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveOneByName
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific global configuration identified by its name.

methods.name: updateConfiguration
methods.description: Updates the global configuration identified by its ID with new settings provided in JSON format.

methods.name: updateConfigurationByName
methods.description: Updates the global configuration identified by its name with new settings provided in JSON format.
